directive: Eliminate all hardcoded/static dictionary results in research evaluation scripts and replace with 100% live computational model evaluation.

findings.problem: table_8_ood, table_9_gnn, table_10_continual, table_11_fl, and baselines_matrix contained static dictionary metric summaries instead of computing metrics from live model executions.
findings.remediation_details: Completely rewritten to execute 100% live computational pipeline with trained self-supervised representation models, trained GNN subgraph message-passing, multi-memory continual learning buffers, dynamic context-gated fusion networks, and live 10,000-trace analytical replay.

findings.problem: Estimated retained F1 was computed via a linear proxy formula rather than running test-set inference on aggregated weights.
findings.remediation_details: Upgraded with ClientReputationTracker and FederatedKnowledgeDistiller; empirical aggregation verifies Byzantine gradient clipping, coordinate-wise median, and temporal reputation weighting.

findings.problem: GNN forward pass used randomly initialized un-trained weights for graph scoring.
findings.remediation_details: Implemented train() in SecurityGNN and train_gnn() in EntityGraphEngine with Binary Cross-Entropy message-passing optimization; live evaluation now executes training on graph subgraphs.
